calls.title: Dave DAngelo and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The team discussed enhancing their lead generation approach by targeting companies with over 1 million monthly visitors, which has already shown an increase in win rates and lead quality. Geoffrey Lugli reported engaging several high-profile prospects, aligning with Ashley Stirrup's strategy to filter out lower traffic firms. They plan to integrate outreach lists from relevant events and utilize internal tools like Apollo and Clay for effective contact sequencing. A new weekly report on content publishing schedules was agreed upon to improve LinkedIn engagement, emphasizing timely posting and interaction. The team outlined plans to target industry-related conferences to attract guests while focusing on local brands in Utah that have sufficient e-commerce traffic. Open communication and timely feedback were highlighted as key for successful lead generation.
calls.keywords: A/B Testing, Lead Generation, Podcast Promotion, ICP Broadening, Conference Outreach, Web Traffic Filtering

calls.title: Dave D'Angelo and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The discussion emphasized building a centralized platform for podcast episode tracking, featuring a live status dashboard to improve guest management. Ashley highlighted her content creation workflow, advocating for the integration of AI while retaining her creative input. The platform team is expected to assist in editing clips and managing social media posts to ensure consistency. Scheduling improvements with dual calendars aim to streamline coordination for recordings and prep calls. Furthermore, there is a need for training sessions between Ashley and the platform editing team to ensure workflow handoffs are smooth. Lastly, performance monitoring metrics will be crucial to analyze content effectiveness across channels and support strategic decisions for future episodes.
calls.keywords: Podcast workflow, content editing, scheduling tools, AI content generation, social media posting, clip selection
calls.action_items:
**David DAngelo**
Build a podcast episode status tracking feature within the platform showing booking, recording, review, and live dates to improve visibility and reduce missed communications (01:25)
Review Ashley's Claude AI skill and explore embedding her workflow and brand voice elements into the platform to complement and enhance content creation (19:15)
Coordinate with Jeff to observe Ashley’s content workflow after a recording session and plan a knowledge transfer session to align clip editing and posting tasks (26:47)
Decide on the scheduling tool for podcast preparation and recording sessions, and communicate any transition plans to Ashley to ensure team visibility and alert management (25:59)
Assign Jeff to lead clip editing and social media post creation based on Ashley’s selected clips and guidance, ensuring consistent content quality and timely posting (21:46)
Investigate integration or delegation possibilities with Buffer for streamlined social media posting, including automatic YouTube link insertion when videos are uploaded (16:17)
Follow up on Jeff’s availability for the workflow observation session and confirm next steps with all stakeholders (28:01)

**Ashley Stirrup**

Share documented content creation workflow and schedule a session with Jeff to walk through the process, enabling smoother collaboration and handoff (26:28)
